## Every managed member moves to its current release

This is the realignment release. Before it, ten of eleven member projects were pinned behind
versions that had already shipped — in some cases by three releases. **All 46 managed member
artifacts now pin exactly to their latest Maven Central release; the drift is zero.**

| Member | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Agent Client (12 coordinates) | 0.25.0 | **0.28.0** |
| Agent Client Protocol (5) | 0.14.0 | **0.15.0** |
| Agent Judge (4) | 0.13.0 | **0.15.0** |
| Agent Journal + captures (3) | 1.6.0 | **1.7.0** |
| Agent Sandbox (3) | 0.9.3 | **0.10.0** |
| Agent Hooks (4) | 0.6.4 | **0.7.0** |
| Agent Bench (2) | 0.4.0 | **0.6.0** |
| Agent Experiment (2) | 0.5.0 | **0.6.0** |
| Agent Memory (2) | 0.3.0 | **0.4.0** |
| Claude Agent SDK (1) | 1.4.0 | **1.5.0** |
| Agent Workflow (8) | 0.10.0 | 0.10.0 (unchanged — already current) |

### What consumers actually gain

- **Agent Client 0.28.0** repairs the published no-BOM consumer graph: direct Jackson and Log4j
  declarations now survive flattened child POMs, so a consumer who imports no BOM still receives
  Jackson 2.21.6 / 3.1.6 and Log4j 2.25.5. It also adds Grok and Antigravity adapters — five
  provider adapters now pass the full ten-scenario parity TCK against live CLIs.
- **ACP 0.15.0** corrects a licence that was not Apache 2.0 despite every POM claiming it, and
  clears 17 CVEs (5 high) that reached every consumer, including `jackson-databind` 2.21.5 and
  Jetty 12.0.37.
- **Agent Judge 0.15.0**, **Journal 1.7.0**, **Sandbox 0.10.0**, **Hooks 0.7.0**, **Memory 0.4.0**,
  **Bench 0.6.0**, **Experiment 0.6.0** and **Claude SDK 1.5.0** each carry their own consumer and
  security corrections through to BOM consumers for the first time.

### Removed

`io.github.markpollack:loopy` is no longer managed. It is a command-line tool rather than a library
a developer takes as a dependency, so governing its version exported nothing useful. This is a
removal from `dependencyManagement`; it does not affect anyone who depends on Loopy directly.

### Verification

Published behind the `bom-verification` gate: **9/9 green** — three consumer scenarios (plain,
Spring Boot 3.5, Spring Boot 4) each passing `RequireUpperBoundDeps` and the Jackson convergence
runtime checks — CI-enforced pre-publish and re-verified from Maven Central post-publish.

### Known, disclosed

Several member repositories still hard-pin siblings behind what this BOM now ships; the largest
group is in Agent Workflow, which is on hold. See the release receipt for the full disposition.
